issue.description:
Useful reminders should surface due work without duplicate alerts or invented delivery claims.

**Scope**
Reuse COL-32's calendar ownership and approved rule inputs. Implement in-app reminders/escalation acknowledgment with digest/duplicate suppression, backup routing and explicit unknown recipient/window; external SMS/email/voice only under later verified channel activation.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Known due/overdue rules create one appropriate in-app episode; resolving/reopening tracks the episode correctly.
- [ ] Unknown deadlines/recipients stay configuration-needed and do not send external messages.
- [ ] Acknowledge/snooze/delivery are not completion; only authorized configured channels can claim actual delivery.

**Dependencies:** [COL-137](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-137/hfo-03-implement-one-recurrence-and-due-date-evaluator), [COL-148](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-148/hfo-10-build-the-staff-today-upcoming-and-history-workspace), [COL-144](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-144/hfo-14-track-problems-next-actions-backup-ownership-and-resolution)
**Related existing work:** [COL-32](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-32/audit-reminder-and-escalation-around-the-building-audits)
**Release:** Connected. Source implementation in progress on `codex/hfo-col152-reminders`, isolated from the existing worktrees and based on the reviewed HFO source stack at `94b1f90a`. This issue is not proof of deployment or staff acceptance.
**Source items:** Shared core contract across all applicable Admin Log items
**Source/code pointers:** `COL-32, OPS-001, R03 R12`. Migration filenames are under `supabase/migrations/`; source paths are relative to Circle-of-Life unless explicitly named otherwise. Reconcile current main before editing.
**Open configuration questions:** Q05, Q29 See [Haven Facility Operations — Source Coverage and Open Decisions](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-source-coverage-and-open-decisions-0bf9ab4bebce).

**Build contract:** [Haven Facility Operations — Build Scope](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-build-scope-fa76df5ada21). **Sequence:** [Haven Facility Operations — Delivery Roadmap](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-delivery-roadmap-eab29aa94849).

One bounded implementation segment at a time. Record exact source/commit, focused behavioral tests, applicable repository segment gates, review and rollback/handoff evidence. Preserve current authority after waits and on retries, existing dirty/concurrent work, source truth and unknown rules. No new dependency, external transmission, clinical/employment decision or policy activation is implied. Keep source/local/hosted/provider/staff/operating-cycle acceptance distinct. No named assignee, estimate or date has been invented.

Roadmap key: HFO-15 / HAVEN-ADMIN-20260909

**Current execution — 2026-09-12:** Codex is the implementer; human assignee remains empty. Live dependency readback: COL-137, COL-148 and COL-144 Done. This segment implements approved in-app reminders only; Q05/Q29 configuration remains explicit and no external channel is activated. COL-143 hosted Storage acceptance remains open and is not waived. Required closeout: focused behavior tests, repository gates, review, exact source revision and remaining release gates.
